title: SCAIL-2: Studio-Grade Character Animation via In-Context Learning
summary: SCAIL is a framework for character animation that enables high-fidelity motion transfer from driving videos to reference images using 3D-consistent pose representation. It effectively addresses common issues like jitter and identity drift while supporting multi-character scenes and long sequences.
research_notes: Developed by Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University; the model is built on the Wan 2.1 architecture and typically requires high VRAM, though quantized GGUF versions are supported.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from the initial SCAIL-Preview to SCAIL-2, which adds enhanced motion stability, improved 3D pose depth understanding, and native support for long-form video generation. It has been integrated into ComfyUI through custom nodes and now supports driving animations via Blender 3D rigs.
